reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact 65x67 source PNG, enlarged existing source-page 13, complete unchanged 2048x2048 raw RGBA and native face/beard and note/right-edge crops, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and evidence, and unchanged naiwa.png; checked mascot identity conversion, broad beard continuity, hair/brows, suit and pocket detail, pose, collar, frame/backplate and note/tab.

remaining_reasons: The complete raw and native face crop remain a photorealistic HUMAN portrait with human skin, human eyes, a human nose and photographic hair, not the required Naiwa conversion with a compact rounded yellow head, green-ringed black eyes and a short broad mascot neck. A correct source composition or realistic beard does not satisfy the character-identity transformation; regenerate the actual mascot conversion while preserving the source features.

The source's small dark right-edge note tab is not retained on the returned note's plain worn right edge. Restore that original compact tab and edge construction when correcting the portrait; do not substitute different hardware.
entries.positive_observation: At a compositional level, slicked-back dark hair, strong separate brows, a grey moustache and a broad connected short grey beard across the lower cheeks, jaw and chin are present rather than a detached goatee. The slight left three-quarter pose, stern single mouth, dark suit, white pointed collar, dark tie and one small white triangular lower-left pocket detail remain. The complete dark frame and opaque dark blue-grey backplate remain. The cream note has two upper gray-mark rows and mostly blank lower paper. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible interior holes, lost backing or working-matte ring. These features cannot qualify the image while the actual mascot conversion is absent and the right-edge tab is missing.
entries.visible_limitations: The exact pale lower-jacket detail, individual beard hairs and note lettering are unresolved at 65x67 and are not rejection grounds. The human-versus-mascot failure is unmistakable in the complete raw and native face crop, and the tab absence is visible on the native note edge; neither decision depends on microscopic source inference or alpha numbers.
